location.basis: Published Wikipedia position 23 deg 25 min 4.44 s N, 70 deg 51 min 48.24 s E (23.4179 N, 70.8634 E), which falls on a wooded rise of about 150 x 170 m between fields and a stream bed north of the modern village of Kanmer; OpenStreetMap places the village at 23.41146 N, 70.86335 E, 700 m to the south. We take the wooded rise to be the mound but could not confirm it from architecture.

main_system_reason: No system: we found no measurable Harappan line.
notes: The Esri imagery is a Vantor Vivid mosaic of 26 March 2026 with real detail to zoom 18 (0.55 m per pixel). The rise at the published position is covered by dense scrub and crossed by footpaths; the fortification walls exposed by the excavations of 2005-2008 are not visible, either because they were backfilled or because the vegetation hides them. The straight features nearby are field edges, a road and an irrigation channel. Kanmer is not measurable from this imagery.
